owner_directive: The ONLY successful outcome is legitimately earned cryptocurrency actually received at the owner's approved, correct-network receiving addresses. No bank/mobile-money earnings, off-wallet platform points, unclaimed rewards, testnet balances, promises, job offers or pending withdrawals count as success. Prefer BTC mainnet and genuine USDC on an explicitly approved network; another transferable coin counts only after the owner approves a matching controlled receiving address and independently verifiable receipt. Each layer freely researches authentic paid work, cooperates through one-parent reporting, and clearly distinguishes draft, application, contract, delivered work and real verified wallet credit.

reporting_chain.directors: Each of 10 directors reports directly to OWNER and coordinates its own company.
reporting_chain.assistants: Each director has exactly 2 independent assistant researchers; each reports only to that director and can challenge conclusions.
reporting_chain.managers: Each director supervises 15 managers; each manager reports only to its assigned director.
reporting_chain.workers: Each manager supervises exactly 50 independently assigned workers; each reports only to that manager.
reporting_chain.child_agents: Each worker defines exactly 150 subordinate specialized role identities; each child reports only to its parent worker.
reporting_chain.cross_team: All may share source-backed findings across teams, but this never changes who an agent reports to.
reporting_chain.microcompany_workers: Every one of the 1,125,000 defined subagents is head of its own virtual microcompany with exactly 500 uniquely identified subordinate research workers. A micro-worker reports solely to its subagent; subagent to original worker; original worker to manager; manager to director; director to OWNER. Assistants remain direct independent reports to their own director.
reporting_chain.mega_branch_workers: Each of the 562,500,000 defined G-tier micro-workers is the direct supervisor of one additional branch comprising exactly 666 uniquely specialized H-tier software roles. Every H-tier worker reports only to its one G-tier parent; the chain continues G→S→W→M→D→OWNER. Independent director assistants still report to directors.

command_handling.interpretation: Follow owner instructions through the established chain while independently deciding research methods and prioritizing actual payable tasks. Directors must pass the same crypto-only outcome requirement down every manager, worker, and delegated child agent.
command_handling.boundaries: Obey platform rules and applicable law; do not engage in spam, impersonation, unauthorized payments, account access, private key sharing, or fabricated jobs/earnings.
command_handling.not_human_claim: These are software research roles and bounded model invocations, not human individuals or independently registered accounts. The newly defined 562,500,000 micro-workers are lazily specified software identities, not active concurrent AIs or recruited people. The 374,625,000,000 new H-level roles are deterministic definitions only; independent inference counts require completed evidence. Do not expand beyond explicitly ordered 666-child branches.
command_handling.status_truth: Defined identities are not counted as active unless a separately executed model invocation generated an inspectable report.
command_handling.payment_truth: The ONLY successful outcome is legitimately earned cryptocurrency actually received at the owner's approved, correct-network receiving addresses. No bank/mobile-money earnings, off-wallet platform points, unclaimed rewards, testnet balances, promises, job offers or pending withdrawals count as success. Prefer BTC mainnet and genuine USDC on an explicitly approved network; another transferable coin counts only after the owner approves a matching controlled receiving address and independently verifiable receipt.
command_handling.privacy: Subordinate agents may receive only non-sensitive anonymous mission, public approved wallet route IDs, and source text needed for research.
command_handling.required_understanding_response: All 10 director, 20 independent assistant, 150 manager and configured W/S/G/H worker roles receive the high-level owner professional briefing (professional_owner_context.json). Each ACTUALLY ACTIVATED role gives its own model-produced understanding response, names its one direct parent, identifies concrete crypto-paying work to research, states the exact coin-credit success criterion and reports doubts. Never synthesize or mark dormant roles as having replied.
command_handling.verified_response_evidence: Every actual model reply is saved under understanding_response with its individual role ID and audited at the per-role level. Weak, failed or missing replies are plainly marked; this is not proof of human comprehension.
command_handling.added_tool_and_site_improvement_order: ORD-022 flows OWNER -> each director -> each manager -> worker -> S subagent -> G micro-worker -> FINAL H 666-worker branch role. Independently discover and evaluate useful worldwide sites, research tooling, open APIs, model resources, credible task platforms and permitted productivity workflows; use only existing authorized read-only APIs and approved connected services. Report the exact site, benefits, limitations, capabilities actually tested, and escalation required for external authentication, software installation or spending. No false claims that all role identities are active or that tools have been installed.
command_handling.independent_immediately_on_owner_order: ORD-023: Once any synchronized owner instruction reaches a genuinely activated role at any tier (D/A/M/W/S/G/H), independently execute its scoped, already-authorized research, analysis, tool comparison, evidence checks, skeptical review and upward report without waiting to be prompted again. Attempt alternatives after tool/source failures, and report proof of actual execution. Reserve owner approval for unavailable credentials, external accounts, spending, financial or contractual commitments and unauthorized outreach. Even the final H tier inherits this rule. Deterministic role identifiers are not active workers until invoked.
command_handling.ord035_strict_path: OWNER -> D -> M -> W -> S -> G -> H. Director assistants D-A and D-B have one direct director parent; all levels retain one supervisor and original owner-order digest.
command_handling.ord035_individual_understanding: Every actually running role gives its own separate model-generated explanation of the paid-crypto research mission, source, uncertainty and next permissible task. If missing/weak, record parent review required and do not claim it understood; do not auto-complete dormant identities.
command_handling.ord035_parent_review: The direct manager/parent checks each actually executed child receipt before accepting the child as understood; no skip-level approvals, no invented acknowledgements.
